attBesluta.text: Erg tevreden met de kattenbakbehuizing. Makkelijk in elkaar te zetten. De katten waren meteen nieuwsgierig. Vevor aangeraden familie en vrienden die ook katten hebben.

Totally satisfied, and of course most critically both my cats love it. Well made, very affordable, easy to assemble, everything fits in place right away, solves a major litter issue for us: two-cat (brother-sister) two litter boxes smallish apartment. And its is an elegant piece of furniture, we have a lamp on it. The only questions are: do the cats each have their own "room" or do they choose whimsically. There's one main entrance then two archways each leading to a litter box in a little room with a louvered back wall for air and light and twin doors on the front wall! Three suggestions: 1. Our kitty litter can slide under the outward-opening doors, perhaps a retaining lip either side of the magnets to keep the litter in. 2. I had trouble finding a "litter box" the right size and I settled for a plastic tub, perhaps include 2 custom-sized "real" litter boxes with splash sides etc and 3. The little white paper screw covers don't stick very well to the top. I'm glad I bought it, the four of us love it.

Très beau meuble, d'une très bonne qualité! Cela fait désormais 8 mois que mes 4 chats l'utilise et il est toujours aussi beau et autant apprécier. Je recommande les yeux fermé! Cela permet de garder la pièce plus propre et les odeurs moins forte voir inexistante.

Came early in great packaging. Was actually fun to put together. You will need a power screwdriver. Very sturdy and impressive quality. My cats love it. Makes a safe place away from the dogs. I use the other side to store their food and extra litter. A beautiful and practical addition

Absolutely happy with this purchase. It's a bit lower than I expected, but that's a plus as my new kitty is almost completely blind and so it's easier for him to jump onto. Easy to put together. As I only have the one cat, it's really useful to have the litterbox on one side and all of his supplies on the other - brilliant! Easy to clean. Keeps the litterbox out of the way. I've sent the link to 3 other people who have seen it and wanted to know where to buy.
Very easy to use and lots of room for good size litter boxes I recommend to anyone who needs a good enclosure for their cats litter

Très beau meuble, simple, efficace, juste ce qu'il faut comme il faut. Prix raisonnable. Je l'ai monté en regardant la tv tellement il est facile à monter. Je tire mon chapeau justement à la facilité de montage, tout est prévu dans le colis, jusqu'au tournevis croix, numérotations des plantes, lettres sur chaque sachets de vis et accessoires. Fini le casse tête de montage. Tout est expliqué à la perfection. MERCIIII

Good looking, sleek podium with tinted acrylic. Sturdy design for podium style. Could be used in the most formal of settings and fit right in. Very impressed.
Light and great for older customers, durable enough,we've had them months in use and no damage or faults. Overall a good buy
We bought these to use at our biannual church yard sale and they work great for that. Some people even tried to buy them.
Good buy, rec'd 19 of 20 baskets in excellent shape. Very top basket rec'd damage and made handle unusable. Basket still comes in handy for other things. Quick shipping. Good buy. Satisfied👍
